name: sunlight-wall-sim
description: 基于地理定位的实时日光墙面模拟器
interaction: The wall renders real-time sunlight for any spot on Earth, synced to your geolocation — golden hour, blue hour, or starry night. Tap anywhere on the map to teleport the wall and watch light and shadow shift instantly. Time-lapse scrubbing lets you replay a full day in seconds.
